purpose: Teach: 高音/逸話/吸引/教区/脱皮/表層/平原/氷河

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、容疑者の声紋分析、高音域の特徴を、警察、把握されてますね
lines.en: You've identified the suspect's voice print characteristics in the high frequencies, haven't you?
lines.style: Thoughtful, analytical. Lean forward slightly. Even pace, deliberately formal. Respectful deference to authority—not submissive, just collaborative. Eyes steady on the officer.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪者の逸話的供述に注意します
lines.en: We're careful to scrutinise anecdotal statements from suspects—hearsay can mislead.
lines.style: Steady, professional tone. No inflection for emphasis. Clear enunciation. Measured pace, like someone accustomed to giving official briefings. Posture upright but not rigid.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、薬物吸引器具の押収を、警察、進められますね
lines.en: You're moving forward with confiscating the drug paraphernalia from the scene, correct?
lines.style: Quiet intellectual interest. Slight upward inflection at the end—a genuine question underneath the formal phrasing. Not rushed. A pause before speaking, like thinking aloud.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、教区を超えた宗教詐欺事件にも対応します
lines.en: We also handle cases of religious fraud that cross jurisdictional boundaries.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact. Slight weight on the scope of responsibility. Calm, professional assurance without boasting. Eyes level, direct but not challenging.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、容疑者の社会的脱皮を、警察、見守られますね
lines.en: So you're monitoring the suspect's… reintegration into society, then?
lines.style: Gentle uncertainty underneath intellectual framing. Slight hesitation before the final clause—checking if he's understood the situation correctly. Warm curiosity, not interrogation.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、犯行現場の表層証拠を採取します
lines.en: We collect surface evidence from the scene itself—photographic, material, impressions.
lines.style: Factual, efficient. Brisk but not rushed. No apologising for the work. Professional pride in the procedure. Eyes forward, settling the matter.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、平原地帯での失踪事件を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: And the disappearance in the flatlands—that's something you're investigating as well?
lines.style: Respectful curiosity. Pause before the final phrase. Acknowledgement that this is a different type of case. Quieter energy than before—this one matters differently.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、氷河地帯での遭難救助も担当します
lines.en: Search and rescue operations in glacial terrain fall under our remit too.
lines.style: Steady, grounded assurance. Weight on the final phrase—this is serious work, difficult work. Eyes level, calm. The kind of quiet confidence that comes from experience.
